name: smwgraphics-asian-dragon
title: Asian Dragon
description:
Anorakun's Notes: A Blargg reskin that is an asian dragon. Since dragons are common figures in some eastern countries like Japan, China and Taiwan, you can fit this nice Blaarg in any kind of chinese / japanese level without much problems. It uses the vanilla palette.

Since so many people liked this Blargg reskin, I thought: "why not share it then?"

Credits should go to No Body The Dragon, not me.
